Messages.Author: ResurrectioN
Messages.Body:
Can an untapped vampire play Eagle's Sight on a d action crosstable and before block resolves play Guardian Vigil?

Issue is if Guardian attempt to block crosstable is allowed because Eagle's enabled it.

Eagle's Sight
[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] This reacting vampire attempts to block the current action, ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking actions.

Guardian Vigil
[aus] +1 intercept, even if intercept is not yet needed.
[cel] This anarch gets 1 optional maneuver in the resulting combat if he or she blocks.
[for] This anarch does not tap for the block.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> ResurrectioN wrote:
> Can an untapped vampire play Eagle's Sight on a d action crosstable and before block resolves play Guardian Vigil?
>
Yes.

www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/75596-guardian-vigil-and-eagle-s-sight
>
> I wrote:
> You can apply an "attempt to block" effect while already attempting to block.
>
> Precedent: Eagle Sight, followed by Black Sunrise  [LSJ 20050708]
>
> > LSJ wrote:
> > .
> > >>>A sequence that does work is: Wake with Evening's Freshness, (Superior)
> > >>>Eagle's Sight, (Superior) Black Sunrise.
> > >>
> > >>Correct.
> > >
> > > Eagle's Sight: Reaction, Auspex
> > > [aus] This reacting vampire gets +1 intercept.
> > > [AUS] This reacting vampire attempts to block the current action,
> > > ignoring the normal prey, predator or target restrictions for blocking
> > > actions.
> > >
> > > Since Eagle's Sight at [AUS] causes a block attempt, don't you lose the
> > > window in which to play Black Sunrise (to untap and attempt to block)?
> >
> > No. You may attempt to block while attempting to block. It is
> > indeed difficult to do otherwise.
> >
> Note that if you aren't an ordinarily eligible blocker then in the case of Guardian Vigil and Eagle's Sight, you need to play the Eagle's Sight first. Since Guardian Vigil makes you attempt to block, you must be an eligible blocker before you play it.
>

I did not expect this so to make it more clear:

Vampire attempts to block action at 0 stealth and plays Guardian Vigil at [cel], [aus], [for]
The vampire has +1 intercept for duration of the action.
Block is successful and the vampire doesn't tap.
He has a maneuver in resulting combat.

In resulting combat opposing vampire plays Form of Mist at superior to continue the action at +1 stealth.
Action continues.

The vampire attempts to block again with +1 intercept.
The blocking vampire doesn't tap and has maneuver in resulting combat.

Is above correct?

I was under the impression that [cel] and [for] effect would be there only for the current block attempt (current being when the card is played).

Messages.Author: Viper
Messages.Body:
Like pointed earlier, the effect of the card lasts until the action ends. The same applies to cards like Precognition or Spirit's Touch, to name some.

Key text is "in the resulting combat". If you block an action with any of the said cards and the opposing vampire plays SUP Form of Mist, then the next block attempt at that action from the same blocking vampire would incur in a resulting combat (assuming you are able to block) and enabling those effects again.

Sorry for continuing down this questions path but better to know now then argue during a game:

Effects of Guardian Vigil carry on onto 2nd block and block attempt if action is continued after 1st one.

How come effect of Eagle's Sight doesn't carry over for 2nd block attempt?
